Motorcar Insurance

Managing a fleet of vehicles means managing risk—accidents, breakdowns, theft, and liability can disrupt operations and drive-up costs. Whether you're in logistics, sales, delivery, or field services, your vehicles keep your business, and disruptions on these assets can derail your operations.

That’s why smart businesses invest in Motorcar Insurance.

At TRINITY, we offer a comprehensive Motorcar Insurance that provides full protection for all damages and losses to the insured vehicle, including liabilities that may be incurred for its use.
• Own Damage
• Theft
• Excess Bodily Injury
• Property Damage
• Auto-PA
• Acts of Nature
• Riot & Strike & Malicious Damage

What is the information needed for Motorcar Insurance?
• Assured's Name
• Location
• Types of cover to be applied - Compulsory Third Party Liability (CTPL) or Comprehensive (Own Damage, Theft, Excess Bodily Injury, Property Damage, Auto-PA, Acts of Nature, Riot & Strike & Malicious Damage)
• Description of unit - brand, model, year
• Fair market value
• Sum insured/limit of liability
• Mortgage, if applicable
• Loss history
• Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
• KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity
